notes: Convenience-store subset. Interest and Purchase Intent tiers only: no Demographic segments and nothing sensitive (health conditions, religion, politics, orientation). IDs and paths copied from the official TSV; the Purchase Intent asterisk is dropped from paths. Brand refs are the prop marker slugs in edge/props/markers.json (ADR 0008 D2). Spoken keyterms map to segments in the demo seed (speech_evidence.py), not here. `related` lists curated, symmetric same-need pairs the auction may match at a discount (weight 0-100); the IAB hierarchy in `path` adds broader/narrower matches on its own. Age-restricted segments (369) are never related to anything, so a related match can't widen alcohol's reach. `label_es` is the Spanish name the console, Dev/QA and advertiser pages show; `label` stays the official IAB name (model prompts, traceability).
